mapper.select: SELECT artist_id, artist_name, artist_image_url, created_at FROM artists ORDER BY artist_name
SELECT artist_id, artist_name, artist_image_url, created_at FROM artists WHERE artist_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY artist_name
SELECT artist_id, artist_name, artist_image_url, created_at FROM artists WHERE artist_id=#{artistId}
SELECT song_id, artist_id, theme_id, song_title, album_image_url, release_date FROM songs ORDER BY release_date DESC
SELECT song_id, song_title, artist_id, theme_id, album_image_url, release_date FROM songs WHERE song_title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY release_date
SELECT song_id, song_title, artist_id, theme_id, album_image_url, release_date FROM songs WHERE song_id=#{songId}
SELECT song_id, song_title, artist_id, theme_id, album_image_url, release_date FROM songs WHERE theme_id=#{themeId}
SELECT theme_id, theme_name, created_at FROM themes ORDER BY theme_name
SELECT theme_id, theme_name, created_at FROM themes WHERE theme_id=#{themeId}

SELECT cr.room_id, cr.room_name, cr.room_description, cr.target_id, cr.theme_id, cr.created_at FROM chat_rooms cr JOIN chat_room_members crm ON cr.room_id = crm.room_id WHERE crm.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY cr.created_at DESC
SELECT room_id, room_name, room_description, target_id, theme_id, created_at FROM chat_rooms WHERE room_id=#{roomId}
SELECT cm.message_id, cm.room_id, cm.member_id, m.nickname, cm.message, cm.sent_at FROM chat_messages cm JOIN member m ON cm.member_id = m.id WHERE cm.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY cm.message_id
SELECT cm.message_id, cm.room_id, cm.member_id, m.nickname, cm.message, cm.sent_at FROM chat_messages cm JOIN member m ON cm.member_id = m.id WHERE cm.message_id = #{messageId}

SELECT cm.message_id, cm.room_id, cm.member_id, m.nickname, cm.message, cm.sent_at FROM chat_messages cm JOIN member m ON cm.member_id = m.id WHERE cm.room_id = #{roomId} AND cm.message_id > #{lastMessageId} ORDER BY cm.message_id
SELECT crm.room_id, crm.member_id, m.nickname, crm.join_at FROM chat_room_members crm JOIN member m ON crm.member_id = m.id WHERE crm.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY m.nickname

SELECT id AS member_id, nickname, NULL AS room_id, NULL AS join_at FROM member WHERE id IN
#{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_rooms ( room_name, room_description, target_id, theme_id ) VALUES ( #{roomName}, #{roomDescription}, #{targetId}, #{themeId} )
INSERT INTO chat_messages ( room_id, member_id, message ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{memberId}, #{message} )
